description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Resent order status. Possible values are : fully_resent, partially_resent.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → resent_status[is] = "fully_resent"

is.description: \* \`fully_resent\` - Order is Fully resent \* \`partially_resent\` - Order is Partially resent

is_not.description: \* \`fully_resent\` - Order is Fully resent \* \`partially_resent\` - Order is Partially resent
